snippet.title: Rogue Fantasy - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The world is fractured. The cycle is yours to break.

⚔️ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4532930/Rogue_Fantasy_EverShifting_Worlds/

Dive into Rogue Fantasy: Ever-Shifting Worlds, a seamless blend of JRPG depth, roguelike unpredictability, and tactical auto-battler strategy. 

In a realm where every journey is a unique odyssey, you must heed the Crystal’s call. Assemble your legendary trio, forge devastating class synergies, and brave ever-changing dungeons where defeat is never the end. It’s a lesson etched in stone.

FEATURES:
- Tactical Auto-Battler Combat: Build your team, trigger powerful synergies, and watch your strategies unfold in real-time.
- Infinite Odyssey: Explore richly themed, procedurally generated worlds filled with unique loot and hidden quests.
- Permanent Legacy: Strengthen your party across runs by unlocking traits and abilities that carry over after every defeat.
- The Power of Three: Carefully select your trio of heroes to tip the odds in your favor against deadly foes.

The journey never ends… will you be the one to shape its fate?

✨ Join the Adventure:
Twitter/X: https://x.com/roguefantasy
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/roguefantasygame/

#RogueFantasy #JRPG #Roguelike #IndieGame #Gaming #PCGaming #Steam
